html: Scavenger receptors are how the macrophage takes the particle in. MARCO binds the bare particle and MSR1 gives a second route, and the particle they bind is carried to the phagolysosome, the acidic compartment where its metals dissolve and where it sets off the inflammasome and autophagy. CD36 works differently. It reads an oxidised lipid carried on the particle's surface and assembles a TLR4-TLR6 pair that starts a sterile inflammatory signal. MARCO carries the strongest evidence in human alveolar macrophages.
